# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.65

## Added

- Backoffice **RX Profile Sync** search now finds pending differences by
  Pharmacy, Patient Transport, Pharmacy Transport, displayed Pharmacy or
  Transport company names, and `Not set` / `not-set` as well as Patient and
  RX identifiers.
- Results can be ordered oldest-first or newest-first so an administrator can
  review and select the exact historical RX records to synchronize.

## Safety

- The search is read-only. RX Profile Sync remains manual, master-admin-only,
  audited per changed RX, and limited to 100 selected RX records per batch.
- No migration, schema change, business-data rewrite, configured RX Action
  change, or proxy/security configuration change is included.
